ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; predominantly low-intensity dark grey and black pixels with limited mid-intensity grey mottling and sparse high-intensity white clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark pigment dominant in lower fluke regions; mid-intensity grey marbled patches concentrated in upper lobes; high-intensity white contiguous clusters localized at the lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a pixel-measured angle of approximately 55 degrees and deep penetration towards the peduncle base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks on the outer edges and lower-frequency, high-amplitude indentations on the inner right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the outer lobe boundaries terminating in sharp, upward-tapering tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, high-contrast circular clusters (barnacle colonies) densely packed at the distal tips of both lobes; secondary scattered white circular spots on the ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous dark, parallel and non-parallel linear streaks (rake marks) cutting across the pigment pattern on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks and heavy barnacle colonization on the fluke tips.
